title: Meta Blames a Claude Tool for Instagram Ban—MIT’s AI Materials Hunt
description:
Meta says a Claude-based tool triggered the mistaken suspension of the No Kings Instagram account. Alex, Jamie and Rufus debate that explanation, explore MIT’s AI approach to finding promising materials, and question how Anthropic’s proposed public-benefit fund would work.

What we covered:
• Meta blames Claude AI tool for erroneous No Kings Instagram suspension
• MIT research introduces multimodal AI for crystal structure discovery
• Anthropic pledges 5% of shares to new Public Benefit Fund

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: When an AI agent causes a disruption at work, who should be responsible?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
